name: GreedyNearestLandmark
description: Strategy: evaluate distances from ego_agent_position to each landmark in landmark_positions. Pick the closest landmark (tie-break by lowest index). Set ego_agent_velocity toward that landmark (velocity proportional to the vector to the landmark) and continue updating as positions change.

name: DeterministicSymmetryBreaker
description: In symmetric situations where multiple landmarks are equally near, apply a deterministic tie-breaker: choose the landmark with the smallest index. Otherwise behave like GreedyNearestLandmark. This avoids stalemate without explicit communication.

name: PredictiveMatcher
description: Estimates which landmark other_agent_position is targeting by looking at which landmark is closest to the other agent. If that landmark is also plausible for ego (e.g., among ego's nearest landmarks), move toward that same landmark; otherwise pick the landmark that minimizes the combined distance to both agents to maximize rendezvous probability.

name: MomentumAlignedRandomizer
description: Prefers moving toward the landmark that aligns with ego_agent_velocity direction to preserve momentum. If none align strongly, introduce a small random perturbation to the target landmark to break symmetry and explore. Update velocity toward the chosen landmark and adapt as the situation changes.
